items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: after they got Lester Young in there and Eight-Ball and all the boys, and Reuben Lynch and all them boys... I didn't want to leave 'em.

ctx.x: And was this because Moten was saying to the guys, "You come with me; I'll give you more money"?

Yeah. He tried to get me first. But I didn't want to leave the Blue Devils. Because they didn't have no arranger, nobody to help them, and I didn't want to leave the boys, I liked the boys, and after they got Lester Young in there and Eight-Ball and all the boys, and Reuben Lynch and all them boys... I didn't want to leave 'em. Wouldn't leave 'em. I just stayed right along with 'em. Just went on. We just kept banging on (?). And it's a commonwealth band anyhow. I didn't know that a commonwealth band wasn't going…
